title: console-reconciliation-playbook-and-live-query-fix
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary:
During a series of customer escalations between 2026-03-08 and 2026-03-10 multiple Console Live Panels and dashboards began returning empty or stale timeseries across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. In parallel, we observed partial trace continuity gaps for a subset of requests (span sampling misalignment). Impact included production monitoring blindspots for three paying customers and multiple internal SRE alerts.

Observed symptoms:
- Live Panels returned 0 rows intermittently for queries that historically returned data.
- Dashboards showed missing metric series and repeated 'no data' tiles.
- Traces for requests that passed through the routing layer showed missing intermediate spans (gaps) and broken links back to dashboard alerts.
- The issue was reproducible in Hosted and Dedicated fleets; Private customers showed both symptoms but with different failure modes.

Root cause analysis (short):
Two related regressions coincided after the 2026-03-06 runtime/planner rollout: (1) A new query optimizer flag (optimize_time_range_pushdown) aggressively rewrote federated/dashboard queries and clipped time windows when a federated shard returned a late-timestamp indicator. For Private deployments with slightly skewed ingest clocks this resulted in empty query windows. (2) A config change in the ingestion retention compactor for Dedicated caused earlier-than-expected tombstone marks for micro-shards, producing gaps in the store used by the Console's materialized query layer. The planner rewrite + premature tombstones together produced the observed 'no data' and trace-link breakage in production.

Mitigation / actions taken:
- Hotfix: reverted the optimizer flag globally for Hosted and pushed toggles for Dedicated/Private (2026-03-10, rollbacks tracked in PR #6123).
- Reindex: launched targeted reindex jobs for affected metric namespaces in Dedicated; for Private customers provided a one-click rehydrate script and s3/backfill instructions.
- Tracing: adjusted span-sampling alignment and fixed the trace ID propagation bug introduced by the planner change. Deployed 2026-03-11.
- Console reconciler: implemented a background reconciler that checks dashboard panels for unexpected zero-row regressions and queues a non-destructive re-run (safe to run across tenants). Canary deployed to 5% of Hosted on 2026-03-12.
- Alerting & runbook: added a detection rule (drop in panel rowcount > 90% within 10m) and authored a playbook with reproduction steps, rollback commands, and customer communication templates.

Longer-term fixes planned:
- Harden federated query planner with explicit clock-skew tolerance and a safe-fallback that preserves full time ranges when any shard reports late data.
- Add a daily reconciler job that validates materialized views against raw ingest for early drift detection.
- Add e2e regression tests in CI that exercise Live Panels against synthetic delayed-shard scenarios.
- Postmortem and customer communication: schedule blameless postmortem + customer incident writeups for next business week.

Acceptance criteria / verification:
- Live Panels no longer return intermittent 0-row results in the Hosted canary and Dedicated canary clusters for 72 hours.
- Affected customers confirm dashboards restored (customer confirmations logged).
- Reindex jobs completed and tombstone rates returned to baseline.

Notes for reviewers:
- The hotfix PR includes an ops-safe toggling interface; review needs to focus on the planner change rollback and the reconciler safety properties (no write-side mutation to production indices).
- The reindex/backfill scripts are destructive-only on materialized views; ensure we preserve raw ingest snapshots for customers who request them.
